changes.abstract: This system maintains information that is used to establish the U.S. nationality and identity of persons for a variety of legal purposes including, but not limited to, the adjudication of passport applications and requests for related services, social security benefits, voter eligibility, employment applications, estate settlements, and Federal and state law enforcement and counterterrorism purposes.

changes.detail: Alert Type info Alert: On Oct. 16, 2026, we published a new edition of Form G-1055, Fee Schedule. The new edition, 10/16/26, includes the Fiscal Year 2027 H.R. 1 immigration-related fees for the following forms: Form I-131, Application for Travel Documents, Parole Documents, and Arrival/Departure Records; Form I-589, Application for Asylum and for Withholding of Removal; Form I-765, Application for Employment Authorization; Form I-821, Application for Temporary Protected Status; and Form I-941, Application for Entrepreneur Parole The new fees are effective Oct. 16, 2026. If you submit a request postmarked on or after Oct. 16, 2026, for a benefit that requires one of these fees, you must include the new fee. Any request postmarked on or after Oct. 16, 2026, without the proper filing fee will be rejected.

Alert Type info Alert: On Sept. 30, 2026, USCIS announced a Federal Register notice that will increase certain H.R.-1 immigration-related fees for fiscal year 2027. These fee adjustments are minor and account for inflation from July 2025 through July 2026. The new inflation-adjusted fees are effective Oct. 16, 2026. If you submit a request postmarked on or after Oct. 16, 2026, for a benefit that requires one of these fees, you must include the new fee for the specific benefit you are requesting.
